parameters.label: Prompt

parameters.description: The URL of the starting frame image to animate. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC, HEIF. Max 30 MB.

parameters.label: End Image Url
parameters.description: The URL of the image to use as the last frame of the video. When provided, the generated video will transition from the starting image to this ending image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF, HEIC, HEIF. Max 30 MB.

parameters.label: Generate Audio
parameters.description: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.

parameters.label: Bitrate Mode
parameters.description: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

parameters.label: Codec
parameters.description: 'auto' uses the default video codec; US backend output is kept unchanged. 'H264' and 'H265' select H.264 and H.265 respectively.

parameters.label: Return Last Frame
parameters.description: If true, also return the last frame of the generated video as an image.

endpoints.description: OpenAI's precision-focused image model, built for premium visual work, extra fidelity on intricate detail, in exchange for longer generation times.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.description: The prompt for image generation

parameters.label: Image Size
parameters.description: The size of the generated image. Supports preset names, explicit {width, height}, or 'auto' to let the model pick the best size. Concrete sizes must have both dimensions as multiples of 16, max edge 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

parameters.label: Background
parameters.description: Background for the generated image

parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Quality for the generated image. Higher settings increase detail, latency, and token usage. Use 'auto' to let the model choose.

parameters.label: Number of Images
parameters.description: Number of images to generate

parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.description: Output format for the images

parameters.label: Output Compression
parameters.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.

parameters.label: Sync Mode
parameters.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

parameters.label: Enable Safety Checker
parameters.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

endpoints.creator: OpenAI
endpoints.description: Precise image editing that changes only what's asked, keeping subject, composition, and background intact, with reference subjects staying recognizable across styles and successive edits.

parameters.label: Prompt
parameters.description: The prompt for image generation

parameters.label: Image URLs
parameters.description: The URLs of the images to use as a reference for the generation. A maximum of 16 images are allowed.

parameters.label: Mask URL
parameters.description: Mask image URL. White marks regions to edit and black marks regions to keep.

parameters.label: Markup Image URL
parameters.description: Transparent PNG containing only annotations (circles, arrows, notes) that guide the edit of the first image. Must match the first image's dimensions. Cannot be combined with mask_url. Reference images are sent unmodified when set.

parameters.label: Image Size
parameters.description: The size of the generated image. Use 'auto' to infer from input images.

parameters.label: Background
parameters.description: Background for the generated image

parameters.label: Quality
parameters.description: Rendering quality for the generated image. For SVG output it controls the reference image used to create the vector.

parameters.label: Reasoning Effort
parameters.description: How much the model plans before rendering, independently of quality (OpenAI `complexity`). Higher levels can help with dense text and complex layouts but add latency.

parameters.label: Number of Images
parameters.description: Number of images to generate. Must be 1 for SVG output. For GIF output, all frames of all outputs share the request's pixel budget.

parameters.label: Output Format
parameters.description: Output format for the images. 'gif' returns an animation.

parameters.label: Output Compression
parameters.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.

parameters.label: Frame Count
parameters.description: GIF only: number of frames. image_size applies to each frame; reduce size or count if the request exceeds the pixel budget.

parameters.label: Frame Duration Ms
parameters.description: GIF only: milliseconds per frame, rounded to 10 ms.

parameters.label: Sync Mode
parameters.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

parameters.label: Enable Safety Checker
parameters.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
